summary: Resets a racing/session-management struct: frees three owned allocations (fields +0x8C, +0x90 and the byte array +0x94), counts the number of '1' entries in that array into +0x98 before freeing it, then reinitializes ~40 scalar and -1-filled fields and memsets a trailing 0x28-byte block to 0xFF. Returns -1.

operations.description: If the allocation pointer at +0x8C is non-null, free it via FreeWrapper_7bcf and clear +0x8C to 0.
If the allocation pointer at +0x90 is non-null, free it via FreeWrapper_7bcf and clear +0x90 to 0.

Zero the counter at +0x98, then if the byte array pointer at +0x94 is non-null iterate its first field +0x8 elements counting entries equal to 1 into +0x98, free the array via FreeWrapper_7bcf, and clear +0x94 to 0.

Reset scalar/vector fields: zero +0x8 and +0x10, set +0xC to 2, write the float value -1.0 into +0x14, +0x18, +0x1C, +0x20, zero +0x34, +0x38, +0x3C, +0x60, +0x64, write -1.0 into +0x68..+0x80, and zero +0x84 and +0x88.
Reset state and index fields: zero +0x9C, +0xA0, +0xAC, +0xB0, +0xB8, +0xC4, +0xC8, +0xCC, +0xD0, +0xDC as dwords and +0xA8, +0xB4, +0xD4 as bytes; write -1 into +0xBC, +0xC0 and +0xD8.
memset the trailing 0x28-byte block starting at this+0xE0 to 0xFF (sentinel fill).

clean_pseudocode: if (array = this->+0x94) { for (i = 0; i < this->+0x8; i++) if (array[i] == 1) this->+0x98++; FreeWrapper_7bcf(array); this->+0x94 = 0; }
